build: Signed Release Shilling Perf, production Swift sources linked into isolated synthetic fixture
outcome: Both proposed production changes were rejected. Earlier production editors were restored; profiling and validation improvements are retained.
method: Three fresh processes per comparison variant, two visits to each editor per process; nominal thermal state.
Typing: ten characters 50 ms apart, then 200 ms inside the measured interval to include the 120 ms debounced model update.
Comparison variants have identical timing. Their focus windows may overlap the end of navigation after field readiness.
Final verification adds a separate 400 ms push-settle interval before focus and screenshots; do not compare these focus intervals directly with the earlier variants.
Application CPU milliseconds across threads, not CPU utilization percent. The final verification ran under Instruments.
Plan: two cycles of six section switches, populated-list readiness plus 500 ms per phase; final listener cleanup check.
Hitch intervals and inclusive CPU stack counts overlap. Do not sum them into wall-time percentages.
Save and menu actions invoke public UIKit handlers on the actual production views; not physical touch or VoiceOver tests.

rejectedPrototypes.change: Account/Category name buffering with explicit Save flush
rejectedPrototypes.reason: Initial short-window gain disappeared after including the final model update; typing CPU increased about 3%.

rejectedPrototypes.change: Per-field focus with an isolated observed keyboard toolbar
rejectedPrototypes.reason: Reduced focus CPU but added CPU during the next update; combined focus-plus-typing medians improved only 0.3%/1.2% for Schedule/Transaction, with mixed callback gaps.
